items.title: 67247_J.C. Higginbotham oral history interview
items.q: I met him when we were playing in the Savoy. You know we had the opposite band. We just say hello and shake hands and call it a day.

ctx.x: What about Glenn Miller? Did you have any -

No, I don't know that much about him. Never had a conversation with him. I met him when we were playing in the Savoy. You know we had the opposite band. We just say hello and shake hands and call it a day.
Glenn Miller was at the Savoy Ballroom?
